A [[Dryad Bow]] is a rare [[Recurve Bow|recurve bow]].

==Acquisition==
'''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]'''
*[[Rragar's Menagerie]]
**[[Hidesplitter's Chest]]

==Dye==
This item cannot be [[dye]]d.

== Trivia ==
* This bow has the only icon with a visible bowstring.
* [[wikipedia:Dryad|Dryads]] are mythological female tree spirits.
* This weapon was added in the [[Game updates/20080306|March 6, 2008 update]], based on the winning design by Marcus Lamprecht from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|2007 Design-a-Weapon Contest]].
